events.content:
Build confirms it: `/product` is now a Partial Prerender — the shell (title) is prerendered as static HTML and only the inventory data streams in dynamically, instead of the whole route blocking on `getInventory()`.

**Fix:** in `app/product/page.tsx:1`, the page awaited `getInventory()` (which calls `connection()`, forcing dynamic rendering) before returning any JSX, so the static `<h1>` was stuck behind the data fetch. I split the dynamic part into an `Inventory` component wrapped in `<Suspense>`, so the title and page shell render/stream immediately while stock/price stream in after.
